description:
Get the full profile for a single fragrance by UUID or slug (e.g. 'tom-ford/oud-wood'). Returns notes pyramid, accords, FOTW classification, perfumer, community score, and more.

See also: `fragrance_similar` for fragrances with similar accord profiles · `fragrance_get_reviews` for community reviews · `fragrance_get_wearing_stats` for when people wear it.
name: fragrance_get
